author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I finally cracked the problem of cloning the Bloomberg UI using LLM

Opus 4.7 or GPT-5.5 can't understand the screen capture to clone the UI correctly on its own, but I just told it to use OpenCV to write some tools to help yourself.

Here is a Bloomberg mockup, it is still work in progress.   After I successfully clone the keyboard and the command line, I am sure it is just the matter of tokens needs to be burnt to get a perfect Bloomberg UI clone.

https://lnkd.in/gU6x8KRm
